title: Open physics data: what license and attribution terms should it carry? Contributions and catalog
description: Contributions, license catalog, and codebook from the moderated discussion at SESAPS 2026 (Kennesaw State University, Nov 12-14, 2026) on what license and attribution terms should accompany open physics data. Each contribution is a one-page perspective in the contributor's own words, approved before posting. The catalog records what physics collaborations' data releases actually carry, coded from public documents.
